summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests KQB198 taken together with imatinib in people with advanced or metastatic gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST). Both drugs are taken by mouth, and the dosing schedule and length of treatment are not stated. The study aims to assess safety, tolerability and how well the combination works; a main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa KQB198 administrado junto con imatinib en personas con tumor del estroma gastrointestinal (GIST) avanzado o metastásico. Ambos medicamentos se toman por vía oral, y el esquema de dosis y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El estudio busca evaluar la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y qué tan eficaz es la combinación; no se indica una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Unresectable or metastatic disease, with GIST confirmed by tissue.
A KIT or PDGFRA mutation found by local blood or tumor testing.
Measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1.
Being in first-line treatment for advanced or metastatic disease.
Age 18 or older, with adequate organ function and performance status.
not_for: Has a KIT exon 9 mutation or the PDGFRA D842V mutation.
Unable to swallow, or has a GI condition that prevents absorption.
Other active malignancy within the last 2 years.
History of hypersensitivity to any component of KQB198 or imatinib.
